map.退保比例和退保率是一回事吗？: Are surrender ratio and surrender rate the same?
map.不是。退保比例是准备金中实际返还给客户的比例（受最小现金价值监管约束），退保率是: No. Surrender ratio is the share of reserve actually returned to the customer (bound by minimum-cash-value regulation), while surrender rate is a business metric of surrendered policies over in-force policies; their denominators differ.
map.退保现金价值（本页代码口径）：现金价值=准备金×退保比例（比例按小数输入）；联动: Surrender cash value (code basis on this page): cash value = reserve × surrender ratio (ratio entered as a decimal); linked values: surrender charge deducted = reserve − cash value, surrender loss rate = 1 − surrender ratio, cash value rate = cash value ÷ max(reserve, 10⁻⁹). Validation: no strict validation, empty values fall back to 0. Rule: no fixed grading; the surrender loss rate always equals 1 − ratio, and the lower the ratio the heavier the surrender charge.
map.退保现金价值（本页代码口径）：现金价值=准备金×退保比例（比例按小数输入，80%: Surrender cash value (per this page's code): cash value = reserve × surrender ratio (enter the ratio as a decimal, e.g. 0.8 for 80%); related values: surrender charge deduction = reserve − cash value, surrender loss rate = 1 − ratio, cash value rate = cash value ÷ reserve (undefined when the reserve is 0, shown as —, with no 10⁻⁹ fallback). Validation: both fields are required and blank no longer falls back to 0; the reserve must be ≥0 (a negative value would turn negative cash value and positive deduction into a result), and the surrender ratio must be between 0 and 1 (above 1 gives a cash value higher than the reserve); otherwise a prompt is shown and the calculation stops. Criteria: no fixed bands — the surrender loss rate always equals 1 − ratio, so the lower the ratio the heavier the surrender charge; the three boundary cases of ratio 0 / 100% and reserve 0 are explained separately. This page is a simplified model (cash value = reserve × ratio) and differs from the cash value table in a real insurance contract.
